tool_args.rationale: The main uncertainty is whether the positive short-horizon response reverses near H = 20.7. The slow-horizon probe tests that directly and helps constrain the slow adaptation term before fitting.

considered_alternatives.option: Fit the four-parameter dual-exponential law now
considered_alternatives.rejected_reason: All five pilots have H <= 0.48. They show positive short-horizon gain but do not reliably constrain the slow term or establish the sign at H = 20.7.

considered_alternatives.option: Fit the sink-coupled adaptation law now
considered_alternatives.rejected_reason: Every pilot has s_grad = 0, so the sink coefficient is unidentifiable; the slow term also remains weakly constrained.
Finer sampling does not directly test whether the response reverses near the forecast horizon.
